conflicts.where: Lesson 1 (How it explains the phenomenon) vs Lessons 5 and 6
conflicts.problem: Lesson 1 says the Area Scale Factor will be investigated in Lesson 2 and the Volume Scale Factor in Lesson 3. Lesson 2 covers the centre of enlargement and L.S.F, and Lesson 3 covers constructing enlargements. Area (A.S.F) is taught in Lesson 5 and volume (V.S.F) in Lesson 6. The lesson numbers should be 5 and 6.
